text: Ƴoogoynooɗo on e wondiiɓe makko ɓen yeeyiroyi mo Misra coggel famɗungel: ngel woni dirhamu-woy limotoo-koy. Ɓe woni welsindoriiɓe e makko sabu hittingol no ɓe ɓoortondira e makko ka yaawi; tawde ɓe anndii wanaa o maccuɗo, ɓe hulani ko'e maɓɓe e yimɓe makko ɓen. Ɗum ko hattirde e yurmeende Alla nden e makko, fii wata ɓe neeɓidu e makko.
